component.name: osreflog
component.summary: See what changed on this system, and what made each change

description.p: osreflog keeps a history of every change to this system's configuration and the command, service, package transaction or app that made it. When something breaks, it shows what changed since it last worked, undoes a change path by path, or finds the change that broke it by trying copies of the system in containers, VMs or a reboot of this machine.

ul.li: A timeline of causes, each with the files it changed and what each change means
What changed between any two checkpoints, with package changes and unwatched gaps
Undo with a dry-run preview: anything that changed since is left alone
A bisect wizard: a test decides each copy, or you do

description.p: The app talks to the osreflogd daemon, which needs a btrfs root filesystem.

screenshot.caption: A cause: the command that ran, the process, and the file it changed
Undo, previewed before anything is written
A finished bisect and the cause it found

description.p: The status shows how much space the kept snapshots hold. Flatpak updates and services in their own slice are recorded the way they should be, and the helpers that summarize and undo changes run confined.

A friendlier app: the open item is marked in the sidebar, causes can be searched, pages open with a clear header, line diffs are colored, loading is animated, and actions confirm themselves with a notification.
First release: the history browser, what changed since a checkpoint, undo with a preview, and the bisect wizard.
